task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook supplies the requested tables, volumes, formula-based forecasts and carrier recommendations. Material corrections remain: its USPS series misses all six governing numerical ranges; exception E2 expressly directs non-standard service despite the standard-only restriction; nationwide totals assume negligible AK/HI volume without source support. Claims covering every 2026 price level also exceed the disclosed missing early-2026 FedEx schedule. The change route requires clarification because current prices placed into the base table would be escalated again and carrier assignments are hard-coded. Rendering, recalculation and human acceptance remain separate, unperformed endpoints.
